summary: Frontend-only verification completed for /strefa-zagrozenia. Route renders on web (port 3001) without crash, displays current component state, and confirms React Native WebView unsupported on web; therefore no OSM tile requests are executed in web preview.

integration_issues.issue: react-native-webview is not supported on web preview, so Leaflet HTML is not executed and tile.openstreetmap.org requests are not made in browser test mode.
http://127.0.0.1:3000/strefa-zagrozenia returns Expo 'Unmatched Route' in this environment; active tested app route is on port 3001.

react_native_issues.issue: Web platform fallback text shown: 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.'

Confirmed in embedded map HTML: <meta name="referrer" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"> is present.
Confirmed in Leaflet OSM layer: referrerPolicy is set to strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary app under test in this run was accessible at http://127.0.0.1:3001. Web check on 3000 showed unrelated unmatched route. Use Android runtime for true WebView/tile behavior validation.
